content.rendered:
“Then Elisha said…Tomorrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour
be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel…”
(2 Kings 7: 1)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

Before Elisha’s prophecy concerning Samaria, an ass head was sold for
eighty shekels, while dove’s dung was sold for five shekels. Because of the
famine, an ass head and dove’s dung were sold at outrageous rates. People
spent so much to buy so little.

After Elisha’s prophecy, a measure (large sack) of fine flour was sold for
one shekel; and two measures (two large sacks) of barley also went for one
shekel. Elisha’s prophecy turned around the fortunes of Samaria, and
instead of using so much to buy little, people used so little to buy so
much.

Friend, are you using so much to achieve so little? Hear God’s prophetic
word: in this season, your little will achieve much. Your little efforts
will bring amazing results. Every little thing you do will bring forth a
heavy harvest in your destiny.

That small business will bring in huge profits; your insignificant contacts
will lead you into high favours that will blow your mind; as you take
little steps, you shall have mighty results that will lead to abundance.

Elisha’s prophecy turned things around so much that even if one had one
shekel, one bought so much; even if one wasn’t rich, one was able to
acquire so much. God will bring you to the point where you may have little
but you will be able to do big things.

Elisha’s prophecy was God’s word for the people in Samaria. Ask God to give
a command that will turn things around in your destiny. Ask God to cause
your little to achieve much.

Isaiah 60 vs. 22 says: “A little one shall become a thousand, and a small
one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.”

Pray With Me: Lord, in this season and beyond, my little shall achieve
much, in Jesus’ name!
